title: approvals: the record page composite lock still answers { locked } only, without the lockSource that #37151 adds to the lock doors
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ② carried out under an existing ruling. The maintainer chose route A on #37151 (record 7148474531, 「加一个『被谁锁』字段」), so no new decision is owed. Source: fleet, filing request 7151706305 from repo:objectstack#3, a carrier of PR #37191.

## What happens

PR #37191 (#37151) adds `lockSource: 'record' | 'master'` to the four lock doors and to the client types. The record page's composite read in `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` (~485–489) builds its own lock answer and keeps only the flag:

```ts
let lock: { locked: boolean } | null = null;
...
lock = answer ? { locked: answer.locked === true } : null;
```

So, after #37191, a record page still cannot tell a line held by its own approval from a line of a held master. The first may be deleted; the second is refused `RECORD_LOCKED`. The record page offers a Delete the server then refuses, which is what #37151 fixes for the grid.

reach: read from code at main 3b4f0b98. It applies to every record page of a master-detail line whose master is under a locking approval.

## Expected

The composite lock passes `lockSource` through unchanged, beside `locked`. `null` still means unreadable or missing. The record page hides Delete on `lockSource: 'master'`, as the grid does.

## Acceptance

- A pin: the composite answers `lockSource` identically to the single lock door, in four cases:
  - a record held by its own approval;
  - a line of a held master;
  - a self-held line under a held master;
  - an unheld record.
- The record page's Delete follows `lockSource`, with a pin.

Blocked-by: #37191

Grading: area:workflow · Feature · p2 (carrying out the #37151 ruling on a fifth door; same effect as #37151) · size XS.
Dedupe: "record-page lock lockSource" and "record-page-routes lock" (open) → only #37151.
